def set_bg(slide, color):
    bg = slide.background
    fill = bg.fill
    fill.solid()
    fill.fore_color.rgb = color

def add_shape_bg(slide, left, top, width, height, fill_color):
    shape = slide.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.ROUNDED_RECTANGLE, left, top, width, height)
    shape.fill.solid()
    shape.fill.fore_color.rgb = fill_color
    shape.line.fill.background()

def textbox(slide, left, top, width, height, text, size=18, bold=False, color=DARK_TEXT, align=PP_ALIGN.LEFT, font_name="Calibri"):
    tx = slide.shapes.add_textbox(left, top, width, height)
    tf = tx.text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = True
    p = tf.paragraphs[0]
    p.text = text
    p.font.size = Pt(size)
    p.font.bold = bold
    p.font.color.rgb = color
    p.font.name = font_name
    p.alignment = align
    return tx

def bullet_box(slide, left, top, width, height, items, size=14, color=DARK_TEXT, line_spacing=1.2):
    tx = slide.shapes.add_textbox(left, top, width, height)
    tf = tx.text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = True
    for i, (txt, bold) in enumerate(items):
        if i==0:
            p = tf.paragraphs[0]
        else:
            p = tf.add_paragraph()
        p.text = txt
        p.font.size = Pt(size)
        p.font.color.rgb = color
        p.font.name = "Calibri"
        p.font.bold = bold

Yes — $6/mo is all-in for the Document Intelligence service itself.

- `BG_OCR_Options_Comparison.md:31,40`: Custom = `0.2 x $30.00 = $6.00/mo` for 200 pages.

- Training / labelling is free — you only pay when you analyze.
- Layout ($2/mo) is shown as the cheaper fallback option if Custom isn't needed.

- VM (zero extra — reuse existing) or App Service (~$13–15/mo) if you later migrate
- Storage / bandwidth / logging — negligible at 25 PDFs/mo
- M365 / SharePoint / Outlook — already licensed, via Graph
- One-time labelling of 15–25 sample BGs
